job_spec.purpose: DRIVE-2056 flow requeue on the fixed loop (f2ceef2ad: io_ref travels as a file, read last in the mm FF scene) at HM 0: GRT-0116 congestion = 42,989 hold buffers inserted at CTS even at HM 10 (std area 31k um2) = the mmff-ioref fake FF reference (route cmd OT_MM_FF_SDC overrode io_ref_routed); HM 0 at route per the 16:45 rule, mm hold ECO after route. Acceptance FF >= 0 (post-route mm hold ECO). Same RTL/recipe/source, 0 cycles. | crash-1945 2026-10-08: requeue of nes_spl_hm10 with OT_FC_THRU_BOW=80. Root cause of the vm8 GRT-0116 crashes: face_chain_place laid same-face pass-through chains (f_s_*->t_s_*, f_w_*->t_w_*, f_su_SE->t_su_SE; 4-6.4k bits) along the face, so every stage sat in the 3-12 um edge band (hot gcells only at the face, 1-17% average use). Interior stages now bow inward up to 80 um; pin stages unchanged; RTL and cycles unchanged. | was: vm8-timing 2026-10-08 (from hbm_vm8_nws_sp_hm10/hm25_a5b5873d9-tt: TT -41.1, FF -63.9/-59.3 at the routed reference, DRC 3). Fixes: (1) ck pin 0.032 wide on the M7 track (was 0.064 = off the M7 WIDTHTABLE: 3 RECTONLY markers on ck[0], every vm8 half has this pin); (2) route_ff_sdc adds physical/common_flow/io_ref_routed.sdc so the mm FF hold repair targets the routed MEAN boundary insertion the verdict uses (nws: all 6,906 output pin flops t_s_row/t_s_wr/s2n/qNW failed FF hold -45..-64 at mean 305 + 50 vs the route's min-insertion vclk 258); (3) OT_MULTI_VT=lvt for the TT miss: 14 r2r endpoints x_f_s_row[*] (S-face pin reg) -> g_o_s2n[*] (seam oreg), a 500 um feedthrough of 9 BUFx12f wire buffers (~640 ps, worst -41.1), plus qNW outputs -25.5 (pin flops on a late clock leaf, insertion 584 vs mean 372). Pure wire, small cone -> LVT first (no cycle). Fallback if short: s2n through ot_hfd_o
